faqItems.q: Is the highest-MERV filter always right for a Scarsdale system?
faqItems.a: No. Select for the target particles while checking fit, bypass, pressure effect, blower and airflow capability, loading, replacement access, and manufacturer guidance.

faqItems.q: Where should humidity be measured in a Scarsdale property?
faqItems.a: Use representative occupied floors or zones and record time, temperature, weather, HVAC operation, and moisture activities so the readings have context.

faqItems.q: Should a Scarsdale IAQ proposal include an ozone-producing device?
faqItems.a: EPA advises against ozone generators in occupied spaces. Ask each electronic-cleaner proposal to disclose ozone emissions, certifications, maintenance, and limitations.
